question: The emblem of the Chera Dynasty that controlled the central and northern parts of Kerala and the Kongu region of Tamil Nadu was _____.
solution:
The correct answer is__** bow and arrow.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** emblem **of the **Chera Dynasty** was the** bow and arrow,** which symbolized their** prowess in warfare**.
 
• The **Chera Dynasty** was one of the three major dynasties that ruled over **South India** during ancient times, the other two being the **Chola and the Pandya dynasties.**
 
• The** Chera Dynasty** was known for their **maritime trade **and had established trade links with** ancient Rome, Greece, and Egypt.**
 
• The Chera Dynasty was also known for their contribution to** literature and art, and their language, Tamil,** was widely used in their kingdom.
 
• The** Kongu region **of Tamil Nadu, which was also under the control of the Chera Dynasty, is known for its **rich cultural heritage **and is home to several ancient temples and monuments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chera Dynasty:**

 
 
• The early Chera empire was created by the **Chera dynasty,** a **Sangam-era monarchy** that united several parts of southern India's western coast and western ghats. 
 
• **Uthiyan Cheral Athan** was the founder of the Chera dynasty.
 
• The Chera dynasty's reign came to an end with **Rama Kulasekhara's defeat** in **1102 AD. **
 
 
 
• **Birds **were a common motif in ancient Indian art and were often used to represent** freedom and spirituality.**
 
• **Fish** was also a common motif in ancient Indian art and was often used to represent** fertility and abundance.**
 
• **Tiger **was a symbol of power and strength in ancient India and was often associated with **royalty and nobility.**
